Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring guidelines for the percentage of resident, nonresident, and foreign students at institutions of higher education.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to setting guidelines for the percentages ofresident, nonresident, and foreign students at fouryear institutionsof higher education; and adding a new section to chapter 28B.10 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.10 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The boards of regents of the University of Washington andWashington State University, and the boards of trustees of CentralWashington University, Eastern Washington University, WesternWashington University, and The Evergreen State College must each setguidelines for the percentages of resident, nonresident, and foreignstudents enrolled at each institution of higher education. Theguidelines must be established annually by formal vote during regularmeetings. As used in this section, "resident student" and "nonresidentstudent" have the definitions in RCW 28B.15.012.
